BTRFS_ALLOW_CONCURRENCY.description: If true, allow concurrent btrfs maintenance jobs (otherwise they run in FIFO order).

BTRFS_BALANCE_DUSAGE.description: Usage percent range for balancing data block groups (space-separated min max).

BTRFS_BALANCE_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to balance periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_BALANCE_MUSAGE.description: Usage percent for balancing metadata block groups (and mixed blockgroups).

BTRFS_BALANCE_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic balance. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_MIN_SIZE.description: Minimal file size to consider for defragmentation.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_PATHS.description: Colon-separated list of paths to defragment periodically. Empty means none.

BTRFS_DEFRAG_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic defragmentation. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_LOG_OUTPUT.description: Output target for messages. Valid values: none, stdout, journal, syslog.

BTRFS_SCRUB_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to scrub periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_SCRUB_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic scrub. Valid values: none, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.

BTRFS_SCRUB_PRIORITY.description: I/O priority for scrub. Valid values: idle, normal.

BTRFS_SCRUB_READ_ONLY.description: If true, perform read-only scrub without attempting repairs.

BTRFS_TRIM_MOUNTPOINTS.description: Colon-separated list of mountpoints/filesystems to trim periodically. 'auto' means all mounted btrfs filesystems.

BTRFS_TRIM_PERIOD.description: Frequency of periodic trim. Valid values: none, daily, weekly, monthly. Also supports systemd.time(7) calendar events.
